ItemSales.net_quantity.description: Quantity sold after returns are subtracted, shown in the item's unit of measure. Use Units sold when you want quantity before returns are deducted

ItemSales.local_reporting_timestamp.title: Item Sales Local Reporting Timestamp
ItemSales.local_reporting_timestamp.description: Full timestamp, where the UTC value of this timestamp represents the same time in the location's local timezone. Note - if using this dimension, you must not include a query timezone (or explicitly set it to UTC). If you need to specify a query timezone, you can use local_reporting_timestamp_str instead, or the individual local time dimensions (local_date, local_hour, local_minute, etc.) instead, as they provide more flexible grouping and filtering aligned with the business's operating hours

meta.label: Date
meta.tooltip: The main date and time this report is measured by, in the location time zone.
